geometry_edits: Replaced the original 32-vertex, 44-face rectangular massing block with structural walls extruded from the exact 16-vertex OSM way 256640455 outline.

Rebuilt the photographed front corner with a dark entry bay, visible Welcome panel, adjacent light-gray paneled storefront, large dark-framed windows, projecting yellow roofline canopy, and small golden arches mark; details are drawn from the exact-address exterior photo.
Kept other elevations neutral because only one exterior corner is photographed; retained a flat low parapet roof and explicitly estimated height.
Preserved asset file, stable ID, collection/object names, identity transform, campus-coordinate frame, and exact source plan ring.
uncertainties: Purdue BuildingShapesZip4 has no separate McDonald's footprint; the prior spatial-only candidate FID 895 is neighboring Seng-Liang Wang Hall and is not the assigned building.
OSM way 256640455 provides identity, address, store URL, and structural outline but no published survey accuracy, height, or floor count.
County parcel geometry is land-parcel context, not the building footprint; the service returned multiple parcel records for this address.
Aerial tile source vintage is not stated; top-down imagery only supports site and low roof massing, not height or facade openings.
Wall height, story treatment, parapet height, and dimensions remain estimates; no measured elevation or height source was located.

The exact-address exterior photo is nighttime, attributed to Akash Patil, has no capture date or compass bearing, and may predate a remodel; it supports only the photographed front corner. Other elevations, facade dimensions, and entrance bearing remain unverified.
